title: Packet Loss Probe Anomaly
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uptime:probe target=internet
| bin _time span=1h
| stats avg(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss by _time
| eventstats avg(packet_loss) as avg_loss, stdev(packet_loss) as sd_loss
| where packet_loss>avg_loss+2*sd_loss AND packet_loss>1
| sort - packet_loss
description: Measures packet loss over time and flags the hours where your internet link is technically up but practically degraded.
value: Packet loss is one of the best explanations for 'the network feels weird' reports; a simple anomaly chart helps you separate congestion from outages.
implementation: Forward packet-loss metrics from an uptime probe or smokeping-style job; alert on loss spikes that breach your normal range.
visualization: Hourly chart of packet-loss percentage with anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when your internet is still connected but is dropping enough packets to make everything feel broken.
